text: Marmalade sleeps across the open doorway. Everyone carefully steps around her. The door remains open.
Drizzle makes one soft raindrop land in a cup. Then another. The rhythm is almost a song.
Drizzle watches a real cloud pass. For a moment the two clouds share one shadow.
Wink weaves a tiny hammock. You lean closer. Wink adds a curtain.
Wink hangs the hammock beside the entrance, with the curtain cord on the inside.
Taffy stretches toward a spoon. The spoon sticks. A second spoon is sent to help.
Taffy leaves a little gap around a new visitor instead of wrapping them in a hug. The visitor steps closer.
Brambleboo turns a leaf toward the torch. You move the torch closer. The leaf turns away. Back a little, then.
Brambleboo chooses a sunny patch outside, keeping one long root curled by the open door.
Mossbit studies a crumb. Then eats it. This took exactly as long as Mossbit required.
Mossbit rests halfway down the garden path. There is plenty of path left for everyone else.
Wisp tries to light the inside of a closed lunchbox. A thin blue line leaks out around the sandwich.
Wisp drifts outside, becomes one small light among many, then returns to light the step.
